name: Takiguchi Kouhei
source:
One of [url=https://vndb.org/c140718]Eisuke Sasaki[/url]'s friends at school.

[spoiler]He speculates that Sasaki's death was not a murder, but rather suicide. This speculation turns out to be correct.[/spoiler]
